verdict.rationale: Aleph's own AI features generate insights and suggestions from the user's data inside the product. The Aleph Agent pulls data across systems, reasons through the analysis and returns cited answers. Scan runs variance analysis with commentary on what changed and why, and suggests interesting dimensions. Mapping agents surface suggestions for the user to approve. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
